title: Typed arrays not updating when keyframed in AnimationPlayer
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot 4.3, Godot 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19041) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.13031.3015) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

Exported typed array that is keyframed in the AnimationPlayer does not update on said keyframes when game is run in the exported build. When run in-editor the array (Rect2i's in this specific case) updates and functions properly. This issue only applies when the property is updated through a keyframe in the AnimationPlayer, when the property is changed in a script it updates properly. In addition, the initial value assigned in the editor to the exported value is recognized and updates to said value at runtime. The issue seems to only occur when the value is changed via a keyframe in the AnimationPlayer.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create node with exported typed Array (Array of Rect2i in this specific case)
2. Add exported variable of type int to node as well
3. Add AnimationPlayer to scene as child of original Node
4. Create new animation, keyframing different values for typed array and integer at various points
5. Assign setter function to typed array and integer that prints values of said properties
6. Set animation to play on startup and loop
7. Play scene in editor and confirm that both properties are updating in the debug display
8. Export project (with debug) with the node/animation player as the main scene and run exported build
9. Confirm through debug window that integer variable is updating properly but the typed array is not

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Test in editor, then export and launch with debug panel to view printed statements

[project files.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19949363/project.files.zip)
